import pulp

# -----------------------------
# Data
# -----------------------------
packages = [
    "Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta", "Epsilon", "Zeta",
    "Eta", "Theta", "Iota", "Kappa", "Lambda", "Mu",
    "Nu", "Xi"
]

weight = {
    "Alpha": 68,
    "Beta": 34,
    "Gamma": 57,
    "Delta": 43,
    "Epsilon": 48,
    "Zeta": 64,
    "Eta": 68,
    "Theta": 56,
    "Iota": 60,
    "Kappa": 54,
    "Lambda": 68,
    "Mu": 67,
    "Nu": 44,
    "Xi": 31
}

capacity = 100          # kg per truck
T_max = 14              # maximum number of trucks we may need
trucks = list(range(T_max))

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Package_Truck_Assignment", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[p,t] = 1 if package p is placed on truck t
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("x", (packages, trucks), cat="Binary")
# y[t] = 1 if truck t is used
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("y", trucks, cat="Binary")

# -----------------------------
# Objective: minimize number of trucks used
# -----------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[t] for t in trucks), "R0_Minimize_Trucks"

# -----------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# -----------------------------

# R1: each package assigned to exactly one truck
for p in packages:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[p][t] for t in trucks) == 1,
        f"R1_assign_{p}"
    )

# R2: weight on any truck cannot exceed its capacity (scaled by y[t])
for t in trucks:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(weight[p] * x[p][t] for p in packages) <= capacity * y[t],
        f"R2_capacity_{t}"
    )

# R3: a truck is considered used if at least one package is assigned to it
for p in packages:
    for t in trucks:
        model += (
            x[p][t] <= y[t],
            f"R3_link_{p}_{t}"
        )

# R4: all decision variables are binary (already enforced by variable type)
# (No extra constraints needed; variable definitions guarantee binary nature)

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Minimum number of trucks used:", pulp.value(model.objective))

# Show which packages go on which trucks
for t in trucks:
    if pulp.value(y[t]) > 0.5:  # truck is used
        assigned = [p for p in packages if pulp.value(x[p][t]) > 0.5]
        total_wt = sum(weight[p] for p in assigned)
        print(f"Truck {t+1} (load {total_wt} kg): {', '.join(assigned)}")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
volume = [
    44, 43, 34, 57, 52, 64, 34, 40, 41, 70,
    69, 44, 65, 35, 48, 62, 54, 33, 70, 52,
    43, 59, 67, 66, 42, 59, 62, 36, 58, 42,
    52, 68, 50, 51, 68, 69
]  # cubic feet, 36 packages
capacity = 100                     # cubic feet per truck
num_packages = len(volume)         # 36
max_trucks = 36                    # upper bound on trucks (one per package)

packages = range(num_packages)     # 0 … 35
trucks   = range(max_trucks)       # 0 … 35

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("TruckLoading", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[p,t] = 1 if package p is placed on truck t
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((p, t) for p in packages for t in trucks),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# y[t] = 1 if truck t is used
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    (t for t in trucks),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize number of trucks used
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[t] for t in trucks), "R0_MinimizeTrucks"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each package assigned to exactly one truck
for p in packages:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(p, t)] for t in trucks) == 1,
        f"R1_package_{p+1}",
    )

# R2: truck capacity cannot be exceeded
for t in trucks:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(volume[p] * x[(p, t)] for p in packages)
        <= capacity * y[t],
        f"R2_capacity_{t+1}",
    )

# R3: a truck is considered used if any package is assigned to it
for t in trucks:
    for p in packages:
        model += (
            y[t] >= x[(p, t)],
            f"R3_truck_{t+1}_pkg_{p+1}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
status = pulp.LpStatus[model.status]
print(f"Status: {status}")

if status == "Optimal":
    used_trucks = [t for t in trucks if pulp.value(y[t]) > 0.5]
    print(f"Number of trucks used: {len(used_trucks)}\n")

    # Build assignment dictionary
    assignment = {t: [] for t in used_trucks}
    for p in packages:
        for t in used_trucks:
            if pulp.value(x[(p, t)]) > 0.5:
                assignment[t].append(p + 1)   # package numbers are 1‑based for readability
                break

    for t in used_trucks:
        pkg_list = ", ".join(str(p) for p in sorted(assignment[t]))
        total_vol = sum(volume[p - 1] for p in assignment[t])
        print(f"Truck {t+1}: Packages [{pkg_list}]  Total volume = {total_vol} / {capacity}")
else:
    print("No optimal solution found.")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
capacity = 100                     # pallet capacity (kg)
num_shipments = 28                 # total number of shipments
max_pallets = 28                   # upper bound on pallets (cannot exceed shipments)

# Shipment names and their masses (kg)
shipment_names = [
    "Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta", "Epsilon", "Zeta", "Eta", "Theta",
    "Iota", "Kappa", "Lambda", "Mu", "Nu", "Xi", "Omicron", "Pi",
    "Rho", "Sigma", "Tau", "Upsilon", "Phi", "Chi", "Psi", "Omega",
    "Aa", "Bb", "Cc", "Dd"
]

shipment_masses = [
    48, 56, 58, 62, 48, 34, 32, 35,
    52, 54, 56, 54, 70, 44, 48, 61,
    55, 65, 30, 70, 57, 70, 48, 61,
    39, 55, 57, 55
]

# sanity check
assert len(shipment_names) == num_shipments == len(shipment_masses)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sets
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
shipments = range(num_shipments)          # 0 .. 27
pallets   = range(max_pallets)            # 0 .. 27

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Pallet_Planning", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,k] = 1 if shipment i is placed on pallet k
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("x", (shipments, pallets), cat="Binary")
# y[k] = 1 if pallet k is used
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("y", pallets, cat="Binary")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise the number of pallets used
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[k] for k in pallets), "Objective_Min_Pallets"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each shipment assigned to exactly one pallet
for i in shipments:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i][k] for k in pallets) == 1,
        f"R1_assign_{i}"
    )

# R2: pallet load cannot exceed capacity (if pallet is used)
for k in pallets:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(shipment_masses[i] * x[i][k] for i in shipments) <= capacity * y[k],
        f"R2_capacity_{k}"
    )

# R3: a pallet is considered used if any shipment is placed on it
for i in shipments:
    for k in pallets:
        model += (
            y[k] >= x[i][k],
            f"R3_link_{i}_{k}"
        )

# R4: number of pallets considered is bounded by number of shipments
# (already enforced by the definition of the pallet index set; no extra constraint needed)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
status = pulp.LpStatus[model.status]
print(f"Solver status: {status}")

if status == "Optimal":
    pallets_used = sum(int(pulp.value(y[k])) for k in pallets)
    print(f"Minimum number of pallets required: {pallets_used}\n")

    # Show which shipments go on each used pallet
    for k in pallets:
        if pulp.value(y[k]) > 0.5:   # pallet is used
            assigned = [shipment_names[i] for i in shipments if pulp.value(x[i][k]) > 0.5]
            total_mass = sum(shipment_masses[i] for i in shipments if pulp.value(x[i][k]) > 0.5)
            print(f"Pallet {k+1} (total mass {total_mass} kg): {', '.join(assigned)}")
else:
    print("No optimal solution found.")

# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("crate_allocation", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,k] = 1 if box i is placed in crate k
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, k) for i in range(num_boxes) for k in range(max_crates)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary"
)

# y[k] = 1 if crate k is used
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    (k for k in range(max_crates)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary"
)

# -----------------------------
# Objective: minimize number of crates used
# -----------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[k] for k in range(max_crates)), "R0_minimize_crates"

# -----------------------------
# Requirements
# -----------------------------

# R1: Each box must be assigned to exactly one crate.
for i in range(num_boxes):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i, k] for k in range(max_crates)) == 1,
        f"R1_box_{i}"
    )

# R2: Total weight in any crate cannot exceed capacity.
for k in range(max_crates):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(weight[i] * x[i, k] for i in range(num_boxes)) <= capacity * y[k],
        f"R2_capacity_{k}"
    )

    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i, k] for i in range(num_boxes)) >= y[k],
        f"R3_used_{k}"

        var_name = f"end_{i}_{k}"
        end[(i, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    for k, (h, dur) in enumerate(ops, start=1):
        model += (
            end[(i, k)] == start[(i, k)] + dur,
            f"R1_duration_{i}_{k}",
        )

# R2 – truck sequence (must respect the given order)
for i, ops in trucks.items():
    for k in range(1, len(ops)):
        model += (
            start[(i, k + 1)] >= end[(i, k)],
            f"R2_sequence_{i}_{k}",
        )

# R3 – hub capacity: at any time only one truck can be loading at a hub
# Build a list of all operations per hub
ops_at_hub = {h: [] for h in hubs}

    for k, (h, _) in enumerate(ops, start=1):
        ops_at_hub[h].append((i, k))

p = {

    ("S2", 1): 7,
    ("S2", 2): 6,
    ("S2", 3): 10,
    ("S3", 1): 8,
    ("S3", 2): 9,
    ("S3", 3): 5,
}

# hub assignment hub[s,k]
hub = {
    ("S1", 1): "H2",
    ("S1", 2): "H1",
    ("S1", 3): "H3",
    ("S2", 1): "H2",
    ("S2", 2): "H1",
    ("S2", 3): "H3",
    ("S3", 1): "H3",
    ("S3", 2): "H1",
    ("S3", 3): "H2",
}

# big‑M (larger than any possible schedule length)
M = sum(p.values()) + 10   # 55 + 10 = 65, safe upper bound

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Logistics_Scheduling", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# start[s][k]  – start time of operation k of shipment s
start = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("start", (shipments, ops), lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# y[i,j,h] – binary ordering variable for two operations i and j that share hub h
# i and j are tuples (s,k)
y = {}
for h in {"H1", "H2", "H3"}:
    ops_at_h = [(s, k) for (s, k) in p if hub[(s, k)] == h]
    for idx_i in range(len(ops_at_h)):
        for idx_j in range(idx_i + 1, len(ops_at_h)):
            i = ops_at_h[idx_i]
            j = ops_at_h[idx_j]
            var_name = f"y_{i[0]}_{i[1]}_{j[0]}_{j[1]}_{h}"
            y[(i, j, h)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# Makespan
Cmax = pulp.LpVariable("Cmax", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# R1 – non‑negative start times (already enforced by lowBound, but we add named constraints)
for s in shipments:
    for k in ops:
        model += start[s][k] >= 0, f"R1_nonneg_{s}_{k}"

# R2 – precedence within each shipment
for s in shipments:
    for k in [1, 2]:  # k and k+1 exist for k=1,2
        model += (
            start[s][k + 1] >= start[s][k] + p[(s, k)],
            f"R2_precedence_{s}_{k}",
        )

# R3 – no overlap at the same hub (disjunctive constraints)
for h in {"H1", "H2", "H3"}:
    ops_at_h = [(s, k) for (s, k) in p if hub[(s, k)] == h]
    for idx_i in range(len(ops_at_h)):
        for idx_j in range(idx_i + 1, len(ops_at_h)):
            i = ops_at_h[idx_i]
            j = ops_at_h[idx_j]
            y_ij = y[(i, j, h)]

            # start_i + p_i <= start_j + M*(1 - y_ij)

                start[i[0]][i[1]] + p[i] <= start[j[0]][j[1]] + M * (1 - y_ij),
                f"R3_no_overlap1_{i[0]}_{i[1]}_{j[0]}_{j[1]}_{h}",

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output (optional, for verification)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    print(f"  y[{i[0]},{i[1]}] before [{j[0]},{j[1]}] at {h} = {pulp.value(var)}")

"""
Scheduling model for four devices with four testing stations.
Minimises the makespan (C_max) using PuLP and the HiGHS solver.

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
devices = ["D1", "D2", "D3", "D4"]          # I = 4 devices
K = 4                                      # operations per device
M = 100                                    # big‑M (minutes)

# processing times p_i_k  (k = 0..3 for Python indexing)
p = {
    "D1": [9, 8, 6, 8],
    "D2": [1, 6, 6, 6],
    "D3": [10, 3, 7, 10],
    "D4": [2, 9, 1, 2],
}

# station assignments m_i_k  (station indices 1..4)
m = {
    "D1": [4, 1, 2, 3],
    "D2": [4, 3, 1, 2],
    "D3": [1, 3, 4, 2],
    "D4": [3, 4, 2, 1],
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Device_Test_Scheduling", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# Start times S_i_k  (continuous, >=0)
S = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("S", (devices, range(K)), lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Makespan
C_max = pulp.LpVariable("C_max", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Binary ordering variables Y_i_j_m for each unordered pair (i<j) sharing station m
Y = {}
for i_idx in range(len(devices)):
    for j_idx in range(i_idx + 1, len(devices)):
        i = devices[i_idx]
        j = devices[j_idx]
        for station in range(1, 5):          # stations 1..4
            # each device uses each station exactly once, so the pair is always relevant
            var_name = f"Y_{i}_{j}_{station}"
            Y[(i, j, station)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise makespan
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += C_max, "Objective_Minimize_Makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R1: start times non‑negative
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in devices:
    for k in range(K):
        model += S[i][k] >= 0, f"R1_start_nonneg_{i}_op{k+1}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R2: precedence within each device
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in devices:
    for k in range(K - 1):
        model += (
            S[i][k + 1] >= S[i][k] + p[i][k],
            f"R2_precedence_{i}_op{k+1}_to_op{k+2}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R3: disjunctive (ordering) constraints for shared stations
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for (i, j, station), y_var in Y.items():
    # locate the operation index for each device on this station
    k_i = m[i].index(station)          # operation index of device i on this station
    k_j = m[j].index(station)          # operation index of device j on this station

    # i before j  ->  S_i_k + p_i_k <= S_j_l + M*(1 - Y)
    model += (
        S[i][k_i] + p[i][k_i] <= S[j][k_j] + M * (1 - y_var),
        f"R3_before_{i}_before_{j}_station{station}",
    )
    # j before i  ->  S_j_l + p_j_l <= S_i_k + M*Y
    model += (
        S[j][k_j] + p[j][k_j] <= S[i][k_i] + M * y_var,
        f"R3_before_{j}_before_{i}_station{station}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R4: capacity of 1 per station
# (Implicitly satisfied by the disjunctive constraints R3; no extra constraints needed)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R5: makespan must dominate each device's completion time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in devices:
    model += (
        C_max >= S[i][K - 1] + p[i][K - 1],
        f"R5_makespan_{i}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R6: variable domains (already declared)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# - S variables: continuous, lowBound=0  (R1)
# - C_max: continuous, lowBound=0
# - Y variables: binary (declared as such)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (C_max): {pulp.value(C_max)} minutes\n")

print("Start times (minutes) for each device and operation:")
for i in devices:
    for k in range(K):
        start = pulp.value(S[i][k])
        print(f"  Device {i}, Operation {k+1} (Station {m[i][k]}): start = {start:.2f}")

        dur = phase_task_durations[p - 1][t - 1]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    for t in range(1, tasks_per_phase):

        model += (
            S[(p, t)] + dur <= S[(p, t + 1)],
            f"R1_phase{p}_task{t}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

M = 1000

    idx_i, team_i, dur_i = tasks[i]
    for j in range(i + 1, len(tasks)):
        idx_j, team_j, dur_j = tasks[j]
        if team_i != team_j:
            continue  # different teams, no conflict
        # binary variable: 1 if i precedes j, 0 otherwise
        var_name = f"X_{idx_i}_{idx_j}"
        X[(idx_i, idx_j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

        # Retrieve start variables for the two tasks
        p_i = idx_i // tasks_per_phase + 1
        t_i = idx_i % tasks_per_phase + 1
        p_j = idx_j // tasks_per_phase + 1
        t_j = idx_j % tasks_per_phase + 1

        # i before j
        model += (
            S[(p_i, t_i)] + dur_i <= S[(p_j, t_j)] + M * (1 - X[(idx_i, idx_j)]),
            f"R2_before_{idx_i}_{idx_j}",
        )
        # j before i
        model += (
            S[(p_j, t_j)] + dur_j <= S[(p_i, t_i)] + M * X[(idx_i, idx_j)],
            f"R2_after_{idx_i}_{idx_j}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R4: start times non‑negative (already enforced via lowBound,
# but we add named constraints for completeness)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for p in range(1, num_phases + 1):
    for t in range(1, tasks_per_phase + 1):
        model += S[(p, t)] >= 0, f"R4_start_{p}_{t}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R5: makespan definition
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for p in range(1, num_phases + 1):
    for t in range(1, tasks_per_phase + 1):
        dur = phase_task_durations[p - 1][t - 1]
        model += C_max >= S[(p, t)] + dur, f"R5_task_{p}_{t}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize makespan
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += C_max, "Objective_Minimize_Makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output (optional, can be removed if only the model is required)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (C_max): {pulp.value(C_max)}\n")

for p in range(1, num_phases + 1):
    for t in range(1, tasks_per_phase + 1):
        print(f"Phase {p}, Task {t}: {pulp.value(S[(p, t)])}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

model += start_A2 + d_A2 <= start_A3, "R1_A_seq2"

model += start_B1 + d_B1 <= start_B2, "R1_B_seq1"
model += start_B2 + d_B2 <= start_B3, "R1_B_seq2"

model += start_A1 + d_A1 <= C_max, "R3_A1"

model += y_A2_B3 + 0 <= 1, "R5_y_A2_B3_upper"

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
num_trucks = 9
num_ops = 9  # operations per truck

# Routes: list of (distribution center, processing time) for each truck (1‑based index)
routes = {
    1: [("D9", 8), ("D6", 5), ("D2", 4), ("D7", 9), ("D1", 10),
        ("D3", 4), ("D4", 2), ("D8", 8), ("D5", 4)],
    2: [("D6", 2), ("D7", 8), ("D3", 7), ("D8", 8), ("D1", 6),
        ("D2", 10), ("D4", 5), ("D9", 8), ("D5", 3)],
    3: [("D5", 2), ("D1", 7), ("D4", 4), ("D6", 5), ("D8", 2),
        ("D7", 7), ("D3", 10), ("D9", 5), ("D2", 9)],
    4: [("D1", 2), ("D9", 2), ("D4", 9), ("D6", 10), ("D7", 3),
        ("D3", 5), ("D8", 6), ("D5", 8), ("D2", 9)],
    5: [("D4", 6), ("D7", 3), ("D8", 2), ("D2", 9), ("D5", 6),
        ("D6", 10), ("D9", 4), ("D1", 2), ("D3", 9)],
    6: [("D2", 1), ("D8", 7), ("D5", 5), ("D7", 9), ("D4", 6),
        ("D3", 4), ("D9", 10), ("D1", 6), ("D6", 5)],
    7: [("D2", 5), ("D8", 8), ("D7", 1), ("D9", 6), ("D1", 6),
        ("D5", 4), ("D6", 6), ("D3", 6), ("D4", 6)],
    8: [("D7", 6), ("D4", 1), ("D1", 7), ("D8", 3), ("D5", 2),
        ("D3", 3), ("D2", 1), ("D9", 9), ("D6", 5)],
    9: [("D4", 5), ("D6", 1), ("D2", 2), ("D5", 8), ("D1", 5),
        ("D7", 7), ("D3", 4), ("D9", 3), ("D8", 8)]
}

# Helper dictionaries for quick lookup
proc_time = {}   # (t,i) -> processing time
center = {}      # (t,i) -> distribution center
for t in range(1, num_trucks + 1):
    for i, (c, p) in enumerate(routes[t], start=1):
        proc_time[(t, i)] = p
        center[(t, i)] = c

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("DeliveryScheduling", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: start times S[t,i] (continuous, >=0)
S = {}
for t in range(1, num_trucks + 1):
    for i in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        var_name = f"S_{t}_{i}"
        S[(t, i)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Makespan variable
Cmax = pulp.LpVariable("Cmax", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R1 – Precedence within each truck
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in range(1, num_trucks + 1):
    for i in range(1, num_ops):
        model += (
            S[(t, i)] + proc_time[(t, i)] <= S[(t, i + 1)],
            f"R1_precedence_T{t}_op{i}"
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R4 – Non‑negativity (already enforced by lowBound, but add explicit)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in range(1, num_trucks + 1):
    for i in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        model += (
            S[(t, i)] >= 0,
            f"R4_nonneg_T{t}_op{i}"
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R3 – Makespan definition
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in range(1, num_trucks + 1):
    model += (
        Cmax >= S[(t, num_ops)] + proc_time[(t, num_ops)],
        f"R3_makespan_T{t}"
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R2 – Resource capacity (no overlap at same distribution center)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Big‑M value: a safe upper bound on the schedule length.
# Sum of all processing times + a safety margin.
M = sum(proc_time.values()) + 100

# For each unordered pair of operations that share the same center, create a binary ordering variable.
binary_vars = {}
for t1 in range(1, num_trucks + 1):
    for i1 in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        for t2 in range(t1, num_trucks + 1):
            for i2 in range(1, num_ops + 1):
                # Skip identical operation
                if t1 == t2 and i1 == i2:
                    continue
                # Enforce ordering only once per unordered pair
                if (t1, i1) > (t2, i2):
                    continue
                if center[(t1, i1)] != center[(t2, i2)]:
                    continue

                # binary variable: 1 if (t1,i1) precedes (t2,i2)
                y_name = f"y_{t1}_{i1}_{t2}_{i2}"
                y = pulp.LpVariable(y_name, cat="Binary")
                binary_vars[(t1, i1, t2, i2)] = y

                # (t1,i1) before (t2,i2)
                model += (
                    S[(t1, i1)] + proc_time[(t1, i1)] <= S[(t2, i2)] + M * (1 - y),
                    f"R2_before_{t1}_{i1}_before_{t2}_{i2}"
                )
                # (t2,i2) before (t1,i1)
                model += (
                    S[(t2, i2)] + proc_time[(t2, i2)] <= S[(t1, i1)] + M * y,
                    f"R2_before_{t2}_{i2}_before_{t1}_{i1}"
                )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize makespan
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += Cmax, "Objective_MinimizeMakespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (Cmax): {pulp.value(Cmax)}\n")

print("Start times (S[t,i]):")
for t in range(1, num_trucks + 1):
    for i in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        print(f"  Truck {t}, operation {i} (center {center[(t,i)]}): start = {pulp.value(S[(t,i)])}")

# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plant generation capacities (MW)
capacity_plant = {
    1: 0,

# Hub demands (MW)

    4: 55,

}

# Transmission line capacities (MW) and loss costs (cost per MW)
line_capacity = {
    (1, 4): 82, (1, 5): 78, (1, 6): 20, (1, 7): 55, (1, 8): 16,
    (2, 4): 52, (2, 5): 19, (2, 6): 9,  (2, 7): 82, (2, 8): 7,

}

    (1, 4): 8,  (1, 5): 10, (1, 6): 6,  (1, 7): 4,  (1, 8): 4,
    (2, 4): 1,  (2, 5): 5,  (2, 6): 2,  (2, 7): 4,  (2, 8): 6,

    (5, 4): 10, (5, 5): 2,  (5, 6): 1,  (5, 7): 2,  (5, 8): 4,
}

plants = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
hubs   = [4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("PowerGrid_MinLoss", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: flow from plant i to hub j (MW), continuous, non‑negative
x = {}
for i in plants:
    for j in hubs:
        var_name = f"x_{i}_{j}"
        x[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total transmission losses
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] * line_cost[(i, j)] for i in plants for j in hubs), "Total_Losses"

for i in plants:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in hubs) <= capacity_plant[i],

        )

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
facilities = ["Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta", "Epsilon", "Zeta"]
plants = ["Delta", "Epsilon", "Zeta", "Gamma", "Eta", "Theta"]

# Production capacities (R1)
capacity = {
    "Alpha":   13,
    "Beta":    76,
    "Gamma":   15,
    "Delta":   34,
    "Epsilon": 57,
    "Zeta":    20,
}

# Plant requirements (R2)
requirement = {
    "Delta":   0,
    "Epsilon": 50,
    "Zeta":    54,
    "Gamma":   34,
    "Eta":     35,
    "Theta":   42,
}

# Throughput limits (R3) and unit costs
throughput = {
    "Alpha":   {"Delta": 28, "Epsilon": 36, "Zeta": 67, "Gamma": 33, "Eta": 21, "Theta": 40},
    "Beta":    {"Delta": 50, "Epsilon": 45, "Zeta": 60, "Gamma": 18, "Eta": 76, "Theta": 41},
    "Gamma":   {"Delta": 83, "Epsilon": 74, "Zeta": 30, "Gamma": 96, "Eta": 42, "Theta": 61},
    "Delta":   {"Delta": 70, "Epsilon": 82, "Zeta": 64, "Gamma": 73, "Eta": 86, "Theta": 38},
    "Epsilon": {"Delta": 39, "Epsilon": 34, "Zeta": 7,  "Gamma": 20, "Eta": 83, "Theta": 96},
    "Zeta":    {"Delta": 17, "Epsilon": 27, "Zeta": 98, "Gamma": 58, "Eta": 36, "Theta": 32},
}

cost = {
    "Alpha":   {"Delta": 5, "Epsilon": 5, "Zeta": 9, "Gamma": 7, "Eta": 5, "Theta": 8},
    "Beta":    {"Delta": 6, "Epsilon": 4, "Zeta": 1, "Gamma": 5, "Eta": 9, "Theta": 2},
    "Gamma":   {"Delta": 1, "Epsilon": 8, "Zeta": 8, "Gamma": 8, "Eta": 1, "Theta": 7},
    "Delta":   {"Delta": 8, "Epsilon": 8, "Zeta": 8, "Gamma": 2, "Eta": 2, "Theta": 2},
    "Epsilon": {"Delta": 4, "Epsilon": 2, "Zeta": 3, "Gamma": 7, "Eta": 4, "Theta": 8},
    "Zeta":    {"Delta":10, "Epsilon": 2, "Zeta": 7, "Gamma": 9, "Eta": 7, "Theta": 1},
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Component_Distribution", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: x_{facility}_{plant}
x = {}
for f in facilities:
    for p in plants:
        var_name = f"x_{f}_{p}"
        x[(f, p)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total transportation cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(cost[f][p] * x[(f, p)] for f in facilities for p in plants), "Total_Cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R1: facility capacity limits
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in facilities:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(f, p)] for p in plants) <= capacity[f],
        f"R1_capacity_{f}"
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R2: plant demand satisfaction
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for p in plants:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(f, p)] for f in facilities) == requirement[p],
        f"R2_requirement_{p}"
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R3: channel throughput limits
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in facilities:
    for p in plants:
        model += (
            x[(f, p)] <= throughput[f][p],
            f"R3_throughput_{f}_{p}"
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R4: non‑negativity of shipments
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in facilities:
    for p in plants:
        model += (
            x[(f, p)] >= 0,
            f"R4_nonneg_{f}_{p}"
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve with HiGHS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output results
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total minimum cost: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f}\n")

print("Shipment plan (units shipped from facility -> plant):")
for f in facilities:

        qty = x[(f, p)].varValue
        if qty is not None and qty > 1e-6:  # display only positive shipments
            print(f"  {f} -> {p}: {qty:.2f}")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flows (unit_flow)
flow = {
    "A": 214.015,
    "B": 51.386,
    "C": 237.741,
    "D": 242.512,
}

# Discharge coefficients (dimensionless)
coeff = {
    "A": 0.986,
    "B": 2.241,
    "C": 1.736,
    "D": 1.11,
}

# Reduction fractions for each technology
red = {
    1: 0.82,
    2: 0.56,
    3: 0.76,
    4: 0.13,
}

# Cost per unit flow for each outlet‑technology pair
cost = {
    ("A", 1): 108.412,
    ("A", 2): 19.541,
    ("A", 3): 57.348,
    ("A", 4): 171.184,
    ("B", 1): 96.728,
    ("B", 2): 162.269,
    ("B", 3): 136.84,
    ("B", 4): 197.7,
    ("C", 1): 123.136,
    ("C", 2): 190.508,
    ("C", 3): 179.371,
    ("C", 4): 126.404,
    ("D", 1): 146.662,
    ("D", 2): 105.908,
    ("D", 3): 167.808,
    ("D", 4): 114.096,
}

# Required overall reduction fraction
P = 0.649

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Water_TDS_Treatment_Plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: flow treated with each technology at each outlet
f = {}
for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    for tech in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
        var_name = f"f_{outlet}{tech}"
        f[(outlet, tech)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
        # R2 – non‑negativity (named)
        model += f[(outlet, tech)] >= 0, f"R2_{var_name}_nonneg"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – Capacity constraints (treated flow cannot exceed total outlet flow)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(f[(outlet, tech)] for tech in [1, 2, 3, 4])
        <= flow[outlet],
        f"R1_{outlet}_capacity",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R3 – Total TDS removal requirement
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline total TDS discharge (no treatment)
baseline_TDS = sum(coeff[o] * flow[o] for o in ["A", "B", "C", "D"])

# Total TDS removed by the selected treatments
total_removed = pulp.lpSum(
    coeff[outlet] * red[tech] * f[(outlet, tech)]
    for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
    for tech in [1, 2, 3, 4]
)

model += (
    total_removed >= P * baseline_TDS,
    "R3_total_TDS_removal",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R4 – Objective: minimize total cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(
    cost[(outlet, tech)] * f[(outlet, tech)]
    for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
    for tech in [1, 2, 3, 4]
)

model += total_cost, "R4_total_cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total cost = {pulp.value(total_cost):.4f}")
print("\nTreatment flows (unit_flow):")
for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    for tech in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
        var = f[(outlet, tech)]
        print(f"  f_{outlet}{tech} = {var.varValue:.4f}")
print("\nVerification:")
print(f"Baseline TDS = {baseline_TDS:.4f}")
print(f"Required removal (P * baseline) = {P * baseline_TDS:.4f}")
print(f"Achieved removal = {pulp.value(total_removed):.4f}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(
    practices[p]["cost"][z] * zones[z]["area"] * x[(z, p)]
    for z in zones for p in practices
)
model += total_cost, "R0_Minimize_Total_Cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_reduction = pulp.lpSum(
    practices[p]["reduction"] * zones[z]["leach"] * zones[z]["area"] * x[(z, p)]

)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
locations = ["Base", "Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta"]
outposts = ["Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta"]
N = 5  # total number of locations (Base + 4 outposts)

    ("Base", "Alpha"): 74.8,
    ("Base", "Beta"): 116.3,
    ("Base", "Gamma"): 125.6,
    ("Base", "Delta"): 132.9,
    ("Alpha", "Beta"): 115.3,

    ("Alpha", "Delta"): 107.7,

    ("Beta", "Delta"): 39.1,
    ("Gamma", "Delta"): 170.8,
}
# Fill the reverse directions (travel times are the same both ways)
for (i, j), val in list(t.items()):
    t[(j, i)] = val

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Ecological_Survey_TSP", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, j) for i in locations for j in locations if i != j),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary",
)

# Order variables for MTZ subtour elimination
u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "u",
    locations,
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=N,
    cat="Integer",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total travel time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(t[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for (i, j) in x), "Total_Travel_Time"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (named constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

model += pulp.lpSum(x[("Base", j)] for j in locations if j != "Base") == 1, "R1_one_out_of_base"

# R2: Exactly one arc enters the Base
model += pulp.lpSum(x[(i, "Base")] for i in locations if i != "Base") == 1, "R2_one_into_base"

# R3: Each outpost has exactly one incoming arc
for k in outposts:
    model += pulp.lpSum(x[(i, k)] for i in locations if i != k) == 1, f"R3_in_{k}"

for k in outposts:
    model += pulp.lpSum(x[(k, j)] for j in locations if j != k) == 1, f"R4_out_{k}"

# R5: MTZ subtour elimination for all ordered pairs of distinct outposts

            model += (

# R7: Base order is fixed to 0

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
N = 4
nodes = [1, 2, 3, 4]

# travel times (symmetric)
travel_time = {
    (1, 2): 124.4, (2, 1): 124.4,
    (1, 3): 102.2, (3, 1): 102.2,
    (1, 4): 132.5, (4, 1): 132.5,
    (2, 3): 112.0, (3, 2): 112.0,
    (2, 4): 11.7,  (4, 2): 11.7,
    (3, 4): 123.7, (4, 3): 123.7,
    # self‑loops (zero travel time, forced to 0 by R3)
    (1, 1): 0.0, (2, 2): 0.0, (3, 3): 0.0, (4, 4): 0.0
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Warehouse_Inspection_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,j] = 1 if the auditor travels directly from i to j, else 0
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    [(i, j) for i in nodes for j in nodes],
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# u[i] = position of warehouse i in the tour (MTZ formulation)
u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "u",
    nodes,
    lowBound=0,   # will be tightened by R5
    upBound=N + 1,
    cat=pulp.LpInteger,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total travel time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(travel_time[i, j] * x[i, j] for i in nodes for j in nodes), "Objective_MinTravelTime"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each warehouse must be departed from exactly once
for i in nodes:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i, j] for j in nodes) == 1,
        f"R1_departure_{i}"
    )

# R2: each warehouse must be arrived at exactly once
for j in nodes:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i, j] for i in nodes) == 1,
        f"R2_arrival_{j}"
    )

# R3: no self‑loops
for i in nodes:
    model += (x[i, i] == 0, f"R3_no_self_loop_{i}")

# R4: MTZ subtour elimination (applied only to non‑depot arcs)
# Choose node 1 as the depot (starting/ending point)
for i in nodes:
    for j in nodes:
        if i != j and i != 1 and j != 1:
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + N * x[i, j] <= N - 1,
                f"R4_MTZ_{i}_{j}"
            )

# R5: tour position bounds
# Fix depot position and bound the others
model += (u[1] == 1, "R5_depot_position")
for i in nodes:
    if i != 1:
        model += (u[i] >= 2, f"R5_lower_{i}")
        model += (u[i] <= N, f"R5_upper_{i}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Total travel time (minutes):", pulp.value(model.objective))

# Extract the tour
tour = []
current = 1               # start at depot (node 1)
visited = set()
while True:
    visited.add(current)
    next_node = None
    for j in nodes:
        if pulp.value(x[current, j]) > 0.5:
            next_node = j
            break
    if next_node is None:
        break
    tour.append((current, next_node))
    current = next_node
    if len(tour) == N:   # completed N arcs, close the loop
        break

print("Tour arcs (i -> j):")
for i, j in tour:
    print(f"  {i} -> {j}")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
sources = ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8"]
clients = ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8"]

source_capacity = [130, 98, 90, 177, 181, 169, 177, 128]          # tasks
client_demand   = [30, 131, 152, 79, 192, 16, 93, 197]           # tasks

latency = [
    [16, 10, 18, 1, 4, 14, 5, 9],   # S1 → Cj
    [12, 13, 12, 2, 13, 2, 19, 18],# S2 → Cj
    [7, 12, 18, 10, 3, 13, 17, 15],# S3 → Cj
    [18, 9, 20, 20, 4, 5, 4, 13],  # S4 → Cj
    [12, 11, 18, 12, 5, 7, 20, 17],# S5 → Cj
    [13, 17, 2, 2, 2, 5, 11, 16],  # S6 → Cj
    [17, 15, 5, 20, 17, 5, 11, 20],# S7 → Cj
    [11, 6, 13, 20, 10, 19, 11, 17] # S8 → Cj
]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("TaskAllocation", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: x[(i,j)] = tasks sent from source i to client j
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, j) for i in range(len(sources)) for j in range(len(clients))),
    lowBound=0,
    cat="Integer"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total latency
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(
    latency[i][j] * x[(i, j)]
    for i in range(len(sources))
    for j in range(len(clients))
), "Total_Latency"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements as named constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – source capacity limits
for i, src in enumerate(sources):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in range(len(clients))) <= source_capacity[i],
        f"R1_{src}_capacity"
    )

# R2 – client demand satisfaction
for j, cli in enumerate(clients):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for i in range(len(sources))) == client_demand[j],
        f"R2_{cli}_demand"
    )

# R3 – non‑negative integer variables (explicitly named)
for i, src in enumerate(sources):
    for j, cli in enumerate(clients):
        model += (
            x[(i, j)] >= 0,
            f"R3_{src}_{cli}_nonneg"
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve with HiGHS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Optimal assignment (source → client : tasks) and latency per task:")
for i, src in enumerate(sources):
    for j, cli in enumerate(clients):
        qty = pulp.value(x[(i, j)])
        if qty is not None and qty > 0:
            print(f"{src} → {cli} : {int(qty)} tasks (latency {latency[i][j]} ms)")

print("\nTotal latency (ms·tasks):", pulp.value(model.objective))

# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
parcel_sizes = [
    54,  # parcel 1

    30   # parcel 14
]

truck_capacity = 100          # capacity of each truck (size units)
num_parcels   = 14            # total number of parcels
max_trucks    = 14            # upper bound on trucks (one per parcel is enough)

parcels = range(num_parcels)          # 0 … 13
trucks  = range(max_trucks)           # 0 … 13

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("parcel_truck_assignment", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[p,t] = 1 if parcel p is placed on truck t, else 0
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((p, t) for p in parcels for t in trucks),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# y[t] = 1 if truck t is used, else 0
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    (t for t in trucks),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each parcel assigned to exactly one truck
for p in parcels:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(p, t)] for t in trucks) == 1,
        f"R1_parcel_{p+1}",
    )

# R2: if a parcel is assigned to a truck, that truck is used
for p in parcels:
    for t in trucks:
        model += (
            x[(p, t)] <= y[t],
            f"R2_assign_{p+1}_{t+1}",
        )

# R3: capacity of each truck cannot be exceeded
for t in trucks:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(parcel_sizes[p] * x[(p, t)] for p in parcels)
        <= truck_capacity * y[t],
        f"R3_capacity_{t+1}",
    )

# R4: all decision variables are binary – already enforced by variable definitions

# R5: minimize the number of trucks used
model += pulp.lpSum(y[t] for t in trucks), "R5_min_trucks"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Minimum number of trucks used: {pulp.value(pulp.lpSum(y[t] for t in trucks))}")

# Show which parcels go on which trucks
for t in trucks:
    if pulp.value(y[t]) > 0.5:  # truck is used
        assigned = [p + 1 for p in parcels if pulp.value(x[(p, t)]) > 0.5]
        total_size = sum(parcel_sizes[p - 1] for p in assigned)
        print(f"Truck {t+1} (size {total_size}/{truck_capacity}): parcels {assigned}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Scheduling model for 5 products across 5 stations.
Minimizes the makespan (Cmax) using PuLP and the HiGHS solver.
"""

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
products = ["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4", "P5"]
K = 5  # number of operations per product
stations = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
M = 1000  # big‑M constant

# durations[p][k]  (k = 0 … 4)
duration = {
    "P1": [1, 2, 7, 5, 2],
    "P2": [4, 2, 9, 5, 6],
    "P3": [10, 3, 3, 1, 9],
    "P4": [7, 3, 3, 9, 2],
    "P5": [3, 4, 7, 6, 10],
}

# stations[p][k]
station = {
    "P1": ["B", "E", "D", "A", "C"],
    "P2": ["E", "C", "A", "B", "D"],
    "P3": ["B", "C", "D", "E", "A"],
    "P4": ["E", "C", "B", "A", "D"],
    "P5": ["B", "E", "D", "A", "C"],
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Manufacturing_Scheduling", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# Start times S[p,k]  (continuous, >=0)
S = {}
for p in products:
    for k in range(K):
        S[(p, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(f"S_{p}_{k}", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Makespan
Cmax = pulp.LpVariable("Cmax", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Binary ordering variables Y[(p,k,p2,k2)] for any two operations that share a station
Y = {}
for p in products:
    for k in range(K):
        for p2 in products:
            for k2 in range(K):
                # avoid self‑pair and duplicate unordered pairs
                if (p, k) < (p2, k2) and station[p][k] == station[p2][k2]:
                    Y[(p, k, p2, k2)] = pulp.LpVariable(
                        f"Y_{p}_{k}_{p2}_{k2}", cat="Binary"
                    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize makespan
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += Cmax, "Objective_Minimize_Makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R1 – Precedence within each product
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for p in products:
    for k in range(K - 1):
        model += (
            S[(p, k + 1)] >= S[(p, k)] + duration[p][k],
            f"R1_precedence_{p}_{k}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R2 – Non‑preemption
# (Implicit: each operation runs continuously; already enforced by start‑time + duration)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# No additional constraints are needed beyond the precedence and capacity constraints.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R3 – Capacity (no overlap on the same station)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for (p, k, p2, k2), y_var in Y.items():
    # If y = 1 then (p,k) precedes (p2,k2)
    model += (
        S[(p2, k2)] >= S[(p, k)] + duration[p][k] - M * (1 - y_var),
        f"R3_capacity_{p}_{k}_{p2}_{k2}_1",
    )
    # If y = 0 then (p2,k2) precedes (p,k)
    model += (
        S[(p, k)] >= S[(p2, k2)] + duration[p2][k2] - M * y_var,
        f"R3_capacity_{p}_{k}_{p2}_{k2}_2",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R4 – Makespan definition
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for p in products:
    model += (
        Cmax >= S[(p, K - 1)] + duration[p][K - 1],
        f"R4_makespan_{p}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R5 – Non‑negative start times
# (Already enforced by lowBound=0, but we add named constraints as requested)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for p in products:
    for k in range(K):
        model += S[(p, k)] >= 0, f"R5_nonneg_{p}_{k}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (Cmax): {pulp.value(Cmax)}\n")

print("Start times (S[p,k]):")
for p in products:
    for k in range(K):
        print(f"  {p} operation {k+1} (Station {station[p][k]}): {pulp.value(S[(p,k)])}")

# Optional: show ordering decisions (useful for debugging)

#     if pulp.value(y_var) > 0.5:
#         print(f"Operation ({p},{k}) precedes ({p2},{k2}) on station {station[p][k]}")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
T = 13
B0_val = 39
Bmax = 42
Rmin = 18
Rmax = 74
delay = 3
c_activation = 4
c_storage = 1
c_penalty = 6
load = [55, 20, 32, 14, 36, 13, 38, 32, 48, 49, 58, 26, 53]  # index 0 → hour 1

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Renewable_Grid_Reserve_Planning", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
R = {t: pulp.LpVariable(f"R_{t}", lowBound=Rmin, upBound=Rmax, cat="Continuous")
     for t in range(1, T + 1)}

B = {t: pulp.LpVariable(f"B_{t}", lowBound=0, upBound=Bmax, cat="Continuous")
     for t in range(0, T + 1)}   # includes B_0

U = {t: pulp.LpVariable(f"U_{t}", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
     for t in range(1, T + 1)}

A = {t: pulp.LpVariable(f"A_{t}", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
     for t in range(1, T + 1)}   # available reserve after delay

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: Initial buffer level
model += B[0] == B0_val, "R1_initial_buffer"

# R2: Buffer capacity for all t = 1..13 (already enforced by variable bounds)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += B[t] >= 0, f"R2_capacity_lower_{t}"
    model += B[t] <= Bmax, f"R2_capacity_upper_{t}"

# R3: Reserve request bounds (already enforced by variable bounds)
# (explicit constraints for clarity)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += R[t] >= Rmin, f"R3_min_{t}"
    model += R[t] <= Rmax, f"R3_max_{t}"

# R4: Reserve availability with delay
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    if t <= delay:
        model += A[t] == 0, f"R4_delay_zero_{t}"
    else:
        model += A[t] - R[t - delay] == 0, f"R4_delay_link_{t}"

# R5: Energy balance each hour
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    # B[t-1] + A[t] = load[t] - U[t] + B[t]
    model += B[t - 1] + A[t] + U[t] == load[t - 1] + B[t], f"R5_balance_{t}"

# R6: Unmet load non‑negativity (already enforced by variable lower bound)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += U[t] >= 0, f"R6_unmet_nonneg_{t}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total cost (activation + storage + penalty)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = (
    pulp.lpSum(c_activation * R[t] for t in range(1, T + 1)) +
    pulp.lpSum(c_storage * B[t] for t in range(1, T + 1)) +
    pulp.lpSum(c_penalty * U[t] for t in range(1, T + 1))
)
model += total_cost, "Total_Cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total cost: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f}\n")

print("Reserve requests (R[t]):")
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    print(f"  Hour {t}: {R[t].varValue:.2f} MWh")

print("\nBuffer levels (B[t]):")
for t in range(0, T + 1):
    print(f"  End of hour {t}: {B[t].varValue:.2f} MWh")

print("\nUnmet load (U[t]):")
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    print(f"  Hour {t}: {U[t].varValue:.2f} MWh")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

        model += (
            start[r][s] + duration[(r, s)] == start[r][s] + duration[(r, s)],
            f"R2_continuity_r{r}_s{s}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    [(p, k) for p in patients for k in procedures],
    lowBound=0,
    cat="Continuous",
)

# Binary ordering variables: Y_i_j_m = 1 if operation i precedes j on equipment m
Y = {}
for m in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    # list of operations that need equipment m
    ops_m = [(p, k) for (p, k), eq in equipment.items() if eq == m]
    for i, j in itertools.product(ops_m, ops_m):
        if i != j:
            var_name = f"Y_{i[0]}_{i[1]}_{j[0]}_{j[1]}_{m}"
            Y[(i, j, m)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += C_max, "Objective_Minimize_Makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: Precedence within each patient
for p in patients:
    for k in [1, 2, 3]:  # k+1 exists for k = 1..3
        model += (
            S[(p, k + 1)] >= S[(p, k)] + duration[(p, k)],
            f"R1_precedence_p{p}_k{k}",
        )

# R2: Equipment capacity – exactly one ordering between any two distinct ops on same equipment
for m in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    ops_m = [(p, k) for (p, k), eq in equipment.items() if eq == m]
    for i, j in itertools.combinations(ops_m, 2):
        model += (
            Y[(i, j, m)] + Y[(j, i, m)] == 1,
            f"R2_capacity_{i[0]}_{i[1]}_{j[0]}_{j[1]}_{m}",
        )

# R3: No‑overlap on equipment (big‑M formulation)
for m in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    ops_m = [(p, k) for (p, k), eq in equipment.items() if eq == m]
    for i, j in itertools.product(ops_m, ops_m):

            continue
        dur_i = duration[i]
        # If Y[i,j,m] = 1 then operation i finishes before j starts
        model += (
            S[j] >= S[i] + dur_i - M * (1 - Y[(i, j, m)]),
            f"R3_no_overlap_{i[0]}_{i[1]}_{j[0]}_{j[1]}_{m}",
        )

    model += (
        C_max >= S[(p, 4)] + duration[(p, 4)],
        f"R5_makespan_p{p}",

            f"R6_start_nonneg_p{p}_k{k}",

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

model.solve(solver)

              f"{pulp.value(S[(p, k)]) :.2f}")

        if dock[i] == dock[j]:

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
T = 8  # number of trucks
R = 8  # number of routes
M = 1000  # big‑M constant

# processing times p[t][k] (t = 0..7, k = 0..7)
p = [
    [3, 4, 8, 6, 1, 6, 8, 10],
    [7, 10, 6, 9, 3, 1, 8, 7],
    [8, 3, 2, 9, 9, 7, 10, 5],
    [4, 10, 5, 7, 8, 9, 5, 2],
    [8, 7, 9, 1, 7, 5, 8, 3],
    [7, 10, 3, 6, 1, 7, 8, 8],
    [10, 6, 3, 3, 8, 2, 2, 3],
    [3, 5, 7, 8, 5, 9, 1, 3],
]

# route identifiers r[t][k] (t = 0..7, k = 0..7)
r = [
    [8, 6, 7, 4, 3, 2, 5, 1],
    [5, 6, 2, 1, 8, 7, 4, 3],
    [8, 7, 4, 3, 1, 6, 5, 2],
    [4, 1, 8, 7, 6, 3, 2, 5],
    [1, 8, 3, 4, 5, 2, 7, 6],
    [7, 6, 4, 8, 3, 2, 5, 1],
    [5, 1, 6, 2, 3, 7, 8, 4],
    [1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 3, 5, 4],
]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Logistics_Scheduling", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: start times s[t,k] (continuous, >=0)
s = {}
for t in range(T):
    for k in range(8):
        s[(t, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(f"s_{t}_{k}", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Makespan
Cmax = pulp.LpVariable("Cmax", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Mapping each (t,k) to a unique global index i = t*8 + k
idx_of = {(t, k): t * 8 + k for t in range(T) for k in range(8)}
# Reverse mapping (optional)
segment_of = {i: (t, k) for (t, k), i in idx_of.items()}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R1: sequential execution within each truck
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in range(T):
    for k in range(7):  # k = 0..6, segment k+1 exists
        model += (
            s[(t, k + 1)] >= s[(t, k)] + p[t][k],
            f"R1_seq_truck{t}_seg{k}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R2: at most one truck on a route at any time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build list of segment indices per route
segments_by_route = {route: [] for route in range(1, R + 1)}
for t in range(T):
    for k in range(8):
        route = r[t][k]
        seg_idx = idx_of[(t, k)]
        segments_by_route[route].append(seg_idx)

# Binary ordering variables y[i,j] for each unordered pair sharing a route
y = {}
for route, seg_list in segments_by_route.items():
    n = len(seg_list)
    for a in range(n):
        i = seg_list[a]
        for b in range(a + 1, n):
            j = seg_list[b]
            # create binary variable y_i_j (1 if i before j)
            y[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(f"y_{i}_{j}", cat="Binary")
            # Retrieve processing times and start variables
            t_i, k_i = segment_of[i]
            t_j, k_j = segment_of[j]
            p_i = p[t_i][k_i]
            p_j = p[t_j][k_j]
            s_i = s[(t_i, k_i)]
            s_j = s[(t_j, k_j)]

            # i before j  =>  s_i + p_i <= s_j   (when y=1)
            model += (
                s_i + p_i <= s_j + M * (1 - y[(i, j)]),
                f"R2_before_{i}_{j}",
            )
            # j before i  =>  s_j + p_j <= s_i   (when y=0)
            model += (
                s_j + p_j <= s_i + M * y[(i, j)],
                f"R2_after_{i}_{j}",
            )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R3: non‑negative start times (already enforced by lowBound,
# but we still add named constraints as requested)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in range(T):
    for k in range(8):
        model += (
            s[(t, k)] >= 0,
            f"R3_nonneg_truck{t}_seg{k}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R4: makespan dominates every completion time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in range(T):
    for k in range(8):
        model += (
            Cmax >= s[(t, k)] + p[t][k],
            f"R4_makespan_truck{t}_seg{k}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R5: no pre‑emption (implicitly satisfied by the model)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# No additional constraints are needed because each segment is modeled
# as a single uninterrupted interval defined by its start time and
# processing time.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize makespan
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += Cmax, "Objective_Minimize_Makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output (optional, can be removed if only the model is required)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (Cmax): {pulp.value(Cmax)}")
for t in range(T):
    times = [pulp.value(s[(t, k)]) for k in range(8)]
    print(f"Truck {t+1} start times: {times}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Job‑shop model for the 10 delivery routes problem.
Each route consists of 10 ordered handling tasks (hub, processing time).
The model minimizes the makespan (total completion time) while respecting
precedence within each route and the single‑machine (hub) capacity.
"""

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Routes are numbered 1..10, hubs H1..H10 are represented as strings "H1",...
# Each entry is (hub, processing_time)
routes = {
    1: [("H9", 2), ("H7", 9), ("H4", 7), ("H6", 2), ("H10", 9),
        ("H1", 1), ("H3", 5), ("H8", 6), ("H5", 6), ("H2", 1)],
    2: [("H8",10), ("H3", 9), ("H1", 4), ("H5", 5), ("H6", 3),
        ("H7", 4), ("H4", 4), ("H2", 8), ("H9", 4), ("H10",4)],
    3: [("H5", 4), ("H6",10), ("H4",10), ("H10",4), ("H9", 7),
        ("H3", 3), ("H2", 8), ("H1", 5), ("H8",10), ("H7", 2)],
    4: [("H2", 8), ("H5", 7), ("H4", 5), ("H1", 4), ("H7", 9),
        ("H3", 6), ("H6", 9), ("H10",10), ("H9", 2), ("H8", 6)],
    5: [("H7", 5), ("H6", 9), ("H2", 3), ("H5", 3), ("H8", 2),
        ("H10",3), ("H4", 2), ("H3", 5), ("H9", 1), ("H1", 4)],
    6: [("H9", 1), ("H6", 7), ("H7", 7), ("H5",10), ("H3", 9),
        ("H1", 9), ("H4", 4), ("H8", 2), ("H10",2), ("H2", 6)],
    7: [("H7", 6), ("H9", 2), ("H5", 1), ("H6", 6), ("H2", 6),
        ("H4", 8), ("H8", 3), ("H1", 9), ("H10",5), ("H3", 1)],
    8: [("H2", 9), ("H8", 3), ("H3", 8), ("H7", 1), ("H4", 2),
        ("H9", 9), ("H10",6), ("H1", 6), ("H5", 7), ("H6", 6)],
    9: [("H4", 1), ("H2", 6), ("H7", 9), ("H8", 8), ("H6", 2),
        ("H10",9), ("H1", 5), ("H3", 2), ("H9",10), ("H5", 6)],
    10:[("H1", 9), ("H3", 1), ("H5", 6), ("H6", 6), ("H2",10),
        ("H9", 8), ("H4", 4), ("H10",8), ("H7", 7), ("H8",10)]
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Delivery_Routes_Makespan_Minimization", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: start time of each task (continuous, >=0)
start = {}
for r in routes:
    for k, (hub, dur) in enumerate(routes[r], start=1):
        var_name = f"start_r{r}_k{k}"
        start[(r, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Makespan variable
Cmax = pulp.LpVariable("Makespan", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
model += Cmax, "R3_objective"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Route precedence constraints (R1)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for r in routes:
    for k in range(1, 10):  # 1..9, each task must finish before the next starts
        hub_i, dur_i = routes[r][k-1]          # task k
        hub_j, dur_j = routes[r][k]            # task k+1
        model += (start[(r, k)] + dur_i <= start[(r, k+1)]), f"R1_route{r}_seq{k}"
        
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Hub capacity (single‑machine) constraints (R2)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gather tasks per hub
hub_tasks = {}
for r in routes:
    for k, (hub, dur) in enumerate(routes[r], start=1):
        hub_tasks.setdefault(hub, []).append((r, k))

M = 600  # big‑M larger than any possible makespan (total processing time = 557)

# Binary ordering variables for each unordered pair of tasks sharing a hub
y = {}  # key = (hub, (r1,k1), (r2,k2)) with (r1,k1) < (r2,k2) lexicographically
for hub, tasks in hub_tasks.items():
    # create ordered pairs
    for i in range(len(tasks)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(tasks)):
            t1 = tasks[i]
            t2 = tasks[j]
            var_name = f"y_{hub}_r{t1[0]}k{t1[1]}_r{t2[0]}k{t2[1]}"
            y[(hub, t1, t2)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")
            dur1 = routes[t1[0]][t1[1]-1][1]
            dur2 = routes[t2[0]][t2[1]-1][1]

            # If y = 1 then task1 starts after task2 finishes
            model += (start[t1] >= start[t2] + dur2 - M * (1 - y[(hub, t1, t2)])), \
                     f"R2_before_{hub}_r{t1[0]}k{t1[1]}_r{t2[0]}k{t2[1]}"
            # If y = 0 then task2 starts after task1 finishes
            model += (start[t2] >= start[t1] + dur1 - M * y[(hub, t1, t2)]), \
                     f"R2_after_{hub}_r{t1[0]}k{t1[1]}_r{t2[0]}k{t2[1]}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Makespan definition (R3)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for r in routes:
    for k, (hub, dur) in enumerate(routes[r], start=1):
        model += (Cmax >= start[(r, k)] + dur), f"R3_makespan_r{r}_k{k}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Non‑negativity of start times (R4) – already enforced by lowBound,
#    but we give explicit named constraints for completeness.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for r in routes:
    for k in range(1, 11):
        model += (start[(r, k)] >= 0), f"R4_startNonNeg_r{r}_k{k}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan: {pulp.value(Cmax)}\n")

print("Start times (route, position, hub, duration, start):")
for r in sorted(routes):
    for k, (hub, dur) in enumerate(routes[r], start=1):
        s = pulp.value(start[(r, k)])
        print(f"  Route {r:2d}, Step {k:2d}: Hub {hub}, dur {dur:2d} -> start {s:.2f}")

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
outlets = ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
techniques = [1, 2, 3, 4]

# concentration (kg nutrient per unit flow)
conc = {
    "A": 1.883,
    "B": 1.181,
    "C": 2.012,
    "D": 2.294,
}

# flow volume
flow = {
    "A": 100.899,
    "B": 208.559,
    "C": 115.996,
    "D": 172.133,
}

# removal fractions for each technique
removal = {
    1: 0.18,
    2: 0.22,
    3: 0.83,
    4: 0.56,
}

# cost per unit flow for each outlet‑technique pair
cost = {
    ("A", 1): 62.569,
    ("A", 2): 10.674,
    ("A", 3): 156.513,
    ("A", 4): 131.052,
    ("B", 1): 59.771,
    ("B", 2): 150.834,
    ("B", 3): 114.819,
    ("B", 4): 91.261,
    ("C", 1): 11.837,
    ("C", 2): 24.296,
    ("C", 3): 177.79,
    ("C", 4): 181.746,
    ("D", 1): 113.662,
    ("D", 2): 168.573,
    ("D", 3): 120.677,
    ("D", 4): 38.138,
}

# required reduction fraction of the initial load
P = 0.264

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Wastewater_Purification_Plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: fraction of each outlet's flow treated with each technique
y = {}
for i in outlets:
    for j in techniques:
        var_name = f"y_{i}{j}"
        y[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: 0 <= y_ij <= 1 for every outlet‑technique pair
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in outlets:
    for j in techniques:
        model += y[(i, j)] >= 0, f"R1_{i}{j}_lb"
        model += y[(i, j)] <= 1, f"R1_{i}{j}_ub"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2: combined removal fraction at each outlet cannot exceed 100%
#      Σ_j (removal_j * y_ij) ≤ 1
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in outlets:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(removal[j] * y[(i, j)] for j in techniques) <= 1,
        f"R2_{i}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R3: total nutrient reduction must be at least P of the initial load
#      Σ_i (conc_i * flow_i * Σ_j removal_j * y_ij) ≥ P * Σ_i (conc_i * flow_i)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
initial_load = pulp.lpSum(conc[i] * flow[i] for i in outlets)
reduction = pulp.lpSum(
    conc[i] * flow[i] * pulp.lpSum(removal[j] * y[(i, j)] for j in techniques)
    for i in outlets
)
model += reduction >= P * initial_load, "R3_total"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total implementation cost
#            Σ_i Σ_j (cost_ij * flow_i * y_ij)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(cost[(i, j)] * flow[i] * y[(i, j)] for i in outlets for j in techniques)
model += total_cost, "Total_Cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total implementation cost: {pulp.value(total_cost):.4f}")

for i in outlets:
    for j in techniques:
        val = y[(i, j)].varValue
        if val is not None and val > 1e-6:  # print only non‑zero treatments
            print(f"Outlet {i}, Technique {j}: treated fraction = {val:.4f}")

        pulp.lpSum(x[(outlet, tech)] for tech in ["X", "Y", "Z", "W"]) <= 1,
        f"R1_sum_{outlet}",
    )

    for tech in ["X", "Y", "Z", "W"]
)
