    [145.205, 123.52, 189.686, 165.843, 131.655, 93.405, 48.324, 134.808, 162.743],
    [64.341, 16.386, 123.908, 108.005, 54.017, 42.202, 16.852, 55.459, 10.055],
    [39.915, 199.395, 158.138, 77.094, 85.077, 121.355, 108.371, 150.016, 23.037],
    [27.132, 64.054, 167.655, 183.852, 76.138, 193.025, 62.536, 125.209, 46.96],
    [186.646, 119.232, 59.61, 87.356, 30.228, 23.753, 65.908, 189.933, 162.559],
]

target_reduction_fraction = 0.678  # P

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Nutrient_Runoff_Mitigation", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[f,p] = 1 if practice p is applied to the whole of field f, else 0
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((f, p) for f in fields for p in practices),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary",
)

# u[f] = fraction of field f that remains untreated (continuous 0..1)
u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "u",
    (f for f in fields),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Continuous",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R1: sum of selected practices + untreated fraction ≤ 1 for each field
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in fields:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(f, p)] for p in practices) + u[f] <= 1,
        f"R1_field_{f}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R2: total nitrogen load after mitigation ≤ (1‑P) * baseline load
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_load = sum(
    leaching_coefficients[f] * cultivated_area[f] for f in fields
)

post_mitigation_load = sum(
    leaching_coefficients[f]
    * cultivated_area[f]
    * (1 - pulp.lpSum(x[(f, p)] * effectiveness[p] for p in practices))
    for f in fields
)

model += (
    post_mitigation_load
    <= (1 - target_reduction_fraction) * baseline_load,
    "R2_total_load",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R4: untreated fractions bounded between 0 and 1 (already set in variable definition)
# Adding explicit named constraints for completeness
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in fields:
    model += u[f] >= 0, f"R4_u_lb_{f}"
    model += u[f] <= 1, f"R4_u_ub_{f}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R5: objective – total implementation cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(
    cultivated_area[f] * cost_matrix[f][p] * x[(f, p)]
    for f in fields
    for p in practices
)

model += total_cost, "R5_total_cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Total implementation cost:", pulp.value(total_cost))

print("\nSelected practices per field:")
for f in fields:
    selected = [p for p in practices if pulp.value(x[(f, p)]) > 0.5]
    if selected:
        practice_names = [chr(ord('A') + p) for p in selected]
        print(f"  Field {f+1}: {', '.join(practice_names)}")
    else:
        print(f"  Field {f+1}: none")

print("\nUntreated fractions:")
for f in fields:
    print(f"  Field {f+1}: {pulp.value(u[f]):.4f}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

x_beta  = pulp.LpVariable("x_beta",  lowBound=None, cat="Continuous")

x_delta = pulp.LpVariable("x_delta", lowBound=None, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: maximize total revenue
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += (
    rev_alpha * x_alpha +
    rev_beta  * x_beta  +
    rev_gamma * x_gamma +
    rev_delta * x_delta,
    "Total_Revenue"
)

    time_alpha_stage1 * x_alpha +
    time_beta_stage1  * x_beta  +

)

start = "Alpha"                      # chosen start (and end) office

# travel times (minutes) – symmetric
travel_time = {
    ("Alpha", "Beta"):    63.4,
    ("Alpha", "Gamma"):   40.6,
    ("Alpha", "Delta"):   90.4,
    ("Alpha", "Epsilon"): 66.0,
    ("Beta", "Gamma"):    103.3,
    ("Beta", "Delta"):    153.8,
    ("Beta", "Epsilon"):  116.7,
    ("Gamma", "Delta"):   52.9,
    ("Gamma", "Epsilon"): 41.6,
    ("Delta", "Epsilon"): 74.3,
}
# make the matrix symmetric
for (i, j), t in list(travel_time.items()):
    travel_time[(j, i)] = t

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Regional_Sales_Representative_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,j] = 1 if we travel directly from i to j (i != j)
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, j) for i in offices for j in offices if i != j),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# u[i] = position of office i in the tour (MTZ formulation)
u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "u",
    (i for i in offices),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=N,
    cat=pulp.LpInteger,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total travel duration
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(travel_time[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for i in offices for j in offices if i != j),
    "objective_min_total_travel_time",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each office has exactly one outgoing arc
for i in offices:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in offices if j != i) == 1,
        f"R1_outgoing_{i}",
    )

# R2: each office has exactly one incoming arc
for i in offices:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(j, i)] for j in offices if j != i) == 1,
        f"R2_incoming_{i}",
    )

# R3: MTZ subtour elimination for all i != start, j != start, i != j
for i in offices:
    for j in offices:
        if i != j and i != start and j != start:
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + N * x[(i, j)] <= N - 1,
                f"R3_MTZ_{i}_{j}",
            )

# R4: tour position bounds
#   u[start] = 1
model += (u[start] == 1, "R4_start_position")
#   2 <= u[i] <= N for all i != start
for i in offices:
    if i != start:
        model += (u[i] >= 2, f"R4_position_lower_{i}")
        model += (u[i] <= N, f"R4_position_upper_{i}")

# R5: binary nature of x[i,j] is already enforced by variable definition (cat=Binary)
#      No extra linear constraint is required.

# R6: integer nature of u[i] is already enforced by variable definition (cat=Integer)
#      No extra linear constraint is required.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output

print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Total travel time (minutes):", pulp.value(model.objective))
print("\nTour arcs (i -> j):")

            print(f"  {i} -> {j}")

print("\nVisit order (MTZ positions):")
for i in offices:
    print(f"  {i}: position {int(pulp.value(u[i]))}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    """Return the travel time for the (undirected) edge {i,j}."""
    a, b = (i, j) if (i, j) in travel else (j, i)
    return travel[(a, b)]

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
facilities = ["P", "Q", "R", "S", "T", "U"]
n_facilities = 6
M = 6  # big-M for MTZ constraints

# Travel times (minutes) – symmetric
travel_base = {
    ("P", "Q"): 37.1,
    ("P", "R"): 49.0,
    ("P", "S"): 77.3,
    ("P", "T"): 66.9,
    ("P", "U"): 61.0,
    ("Q", "R"): 24.1,
    ("Q", "S"): 89.1,
    ("Q", "T"): 40.0,
    ("Q", "U"): 27.7,
    ("R", "S"): 74.0,
    ("R", "T"): 59.7,
    ("R", "U"): 16.3,
    ("S", "T"): 129.2,
    ("S", "U"): 89.0,
    ("T", "U"): 52.4,
}
# make the dictionary symmetric
travel = {}
for (i, j), t in travel_base.items():
    travel[(i, j)] = t
    travel[(j, i)] = t

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Technician_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x_i_j = 1 if the tour goes directly from i to j
x = {}
for i in facilities:
    for j in facilities:
        if i != j:
            var_name = f"x_{i}{j}"
            x[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# u_i = position of facility i in the tour (MTZ formulation)
u = {}
for i in facilities:
    var_name = f"u_{i}"
    u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=1, upBound=n_facilities, cat="Integer")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total travel time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(travel[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for i in facilities for j in facilities if i != j), "TotalTravelTime"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each facility has exactly one outgoing arc
for i in facilities:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in facilities if i != j) == 1,
        f"R1_out_{i}",
    )

# R2: each facility has exactly one incoming arc
for j in facilities:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for i in facilities if i != j) == 1,
        f"R2_in_{j}",
    )

# R3: MTZ subtour elimination (i and j not the start facility P)
for i in facilities:
    for j in facilities:
        if i != j and i != "P" and j != "P":
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + M * x[(i, j)] <= M - 1,
                f"R3_{i}_{j}",
            )

# R4: position of the start facility P is fixed to 1
model += (u["P"] == 1, "R4_start_position")

# R5: binary nature of x variables (explicit bounds, even though type is binary)
for i in facilities:
    for j in facilities:
        if i != j:
            model += (x[(i, j)] >= 0, f"R5_lb_{i}{j}")
            model += (x[(i, j)] <= 1, f"R5_ub_{i}{j}")

# R6: u variables are integers in [1, n_facilities] (explicit bounds)
for i in facilities:
    model += (u[i] >= 1, f"R6_lb_{i}")
    model += (u[i] <= n_facilities, f"R6_ub_{i}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Total travel time (minutes):", pulp.value(model.objective))

print("\nTour arcs (i -> j):")
for (i, j), var in x.items():
    if pulp.value(var) > 0.5:  # selected arcs
        print(f"  {i} -> {j} (time = {travel[(i,j)]} min)")

print("\nFacility positions in the tour:")
for i in facilities:
    print(f"  {i}: position {pulp.value(u[i])}")

import pulp

# -----------------------------
# Data from the problem statement
# -----------------------------
warehouses = list(range(1, 11))          # W1 .. W10
sites = list(range(1, 11))               # S1 .. S10

warehouse_inventory = [
    85,   # W1
    157,  # W2
    76,   # W3
    180,  # W4
    80,   # W5
    122,  # W6
    79,   # W7
    77,   # W8
    177,  # W9
    100   # W10
]

site_demand = [
    117,  # S1
    125,  # S2
    147,  # S3
    54,   # S4
    61,   # S5
    24,   # S6
    82,   # S7
    136,  # S8
    103,  # S9
    72    # S10
]

delivery_cost = [
    [8, 1, 1, 3, 4, 19, 16, 5, 3, 17],   # from W1
    [3, 4, 9, 8, 15, 10, 9, 15, 2, 4],   # from W2
    [6, 2, 10, 12, 11, 14, 4, 4, 2, 1],  # from W3
    [5, 6, 11, 12, 15, 20, 9, 3, 12, 11],# from W4
    [6, 4, 13, 13, 15, 9, 13, 16, 14, 6],# from W5
    [4, 5, 2, 6, 4, 14, 19, 16, 19, 15], # from W6
    [6, 20, 13, 12, 20, 1, 5, 16, 16, 4],# from W7
    [14, 15, 2, 3, 9, 11, 1, 17, 19, 19],# from W8
    [8, 11, 17, 17, 20, 4, 14, 8, 16, 12],# from W9
    [13, 5, 18, 20, 2, 1, 6, 17, 16, 16] # from W10
]

# -----------------------------
# Model definition
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Logistics_Equipment_Distribution", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: x[i][j] = units shipped from warehouse i to site j
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    (warehouses, sites),
    lowBound=0,
    cat=pulp.LpInteger
)

# -----------------------------
# Objective: minimize total delivery cost
# -----------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(
    delivery_cost[i-1][j-1] * x[i][j] for i in warehouses for j in sites
), "Total_Delivery_Cost"

# -----------------------------
# Requirement R1: inventory limits at each warehouse
# -----------------------------
for i in warehouses:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i][j] for j in sites) <= warehouse_inventory[i-1],
        f"R1_warehouse_{i}"
    )

# -----------------------------
# Requirement R2: meet exact demand at each site
# -----------------------------
for j in sites:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i][j] for i in warehouses) == site_demand[j-1],
        f"R2_site_{j}"
    )

# -----------------------------
# Requirement R3: non‑negative shipment quantities
# (already enforced by lowBound, but added explicitly as required)
# -----------------------------
for i in warehouses:
    for j in sites:
        model += (
            x[i][j] >= 0,
            f"R3_nonneg_{i}_{j}"
        )

# -----------------------------
# Solve with HiGHS solver
# -----------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# -----------------------------
# Output results (optional, for verification)
# -----------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total minimum cost: {pulp.value(model.objective)}\n")

for i in warehouses:
    for j in sites:
        qty = x[i][j].varValue
        if qty is not None and qty > 0:
            print(f"Ship {int(qty)} units from Warehouse W{i} to Site S{j}")

u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("u", range(1, N + 1), lowBound=1, upBound=N, cat="Integer")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(d[(i, j)] * x[i][j] for i in range(1, N + 1)

    model += (pulp.lpSum(x[i][j] for j in range(1, N + 1) if j != i) == 1,

# Remaining hubs must be in {2,…,N}
for i in range(2, N + 1):

    model += (u[i] <= N, f"R4_upper_{i}")

# R5: no self‑loops

    model += (x[i][i] == 0, f"R5_self_{i}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
if pulp.LpStatus[model.status] == "Optimal":
    print(f"Total distance: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f} km")

else:

    ("Delta", "North"): 4,
    ("Delta", "South"): 4,
    ("Delta", "East"): 18,
    ("Delta", "West"): 5,
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Technician_Dispatch", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: number of technicians sent from a center to an office
# Variables are integer and have a lower bound of 0 (non‑negative)

    "x",
    (centers, offices),
    lowBound=0,
    cat=pulp.LpInteger,
)

    pulp.lpSum(cost[(c, o)] * x[c][o] for c in centers for o in offices),
    "Total_Travel_Cost",
)

for c in centers:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[c][o] for o in offices) <= supply[c],
        f"R1_supply_{c}",
    )

# R2: Demand constraints (must meet exact staffing requirement at each office)
for o in offices:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[c][o] for c in centers) == demand[o],
        f"R2_demand_{o}",
    )

for c in centers:
    for o in offices:
        model += (
            x[c][o] >= 0,
            f"R3_nonneg_{c}_{o}",

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
